statements: MSMT identifies the Pyongyang Information Technology Bureau (PITB) as an IT-worker entity formerly under the Science and Education Department of the Workers' Party of Korea Central Committee.
MSMT reports that former PITB personnel based in Laos were transferred in 2023 to the Ministry of State Security to support expansion of IT-work operations.

The source describes DPRK-based Ministry of State Security teams as conducting remote IT work and malicious cyber operations, but does not establish that those functions were identical in every team or case.
